networkAccess.reasoning: Token extraction is fully client-side. Two optional features dial out: the delivery step POSTs the generated package to a user-configured receiver endpoint (which may be any host — local, Tailscale, CI), and the agent listener talks to a loopback bridge the designer runs on a port they choose. Neither host nor port can be fixed ahead of time, and allowedDomains takes whole URLs — a port cannot be wildcarded — so the entry stays the wildcard rather than a list that would be wrong for half the team.
